expectation: Membrane ring on a sparse subset of NK cells and some CD8 T cells, scattered single cells or small clusters in the lamina propria and intraepithelial; a few percent of cells at most; the rest of the tissue near background.
observed: A shows diffuse yellow haze over the whole mucosa that follows tissue density and outline, with brighter glow in crypt and villus cores, and the image is duplicated side by side. B and C show broad haze filling stroma and epithelium, with no discrete cells. D shows a diffuse glow with faint rings round nuclei and no distinct bright subset.
why: Signal is a tissue-wide haze following density and morphology, with no distinct sparse membrane-stained NK/CD8 subset.
notes: Diffuse haze tracks tissue density and lamina propria rather than a cell type. No isolated membrane-ringed cells in B, C or D, and none of the sparse scattered pattern expected for NKG2A.
